================================================================================
SECTION 1: REGULAR COMMERCIAL SUPPLY (7 CORE PRODUCTS)
================================================================================

1. COMMERCIAL GRADE CASTOR OIL (NDEVOLEO™ COMM)
- CAS Number: 8001-79-4 | EINECS: 232-293-8 | HS Code: 1515.30.90
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Clear, viscous, pale yellowish liquid
- Free Fatty Acids (FFA): 1.00% – 2.00% Max (as Oleic)
- Acid Value: 2.0 – 4.0 mg KOH/g
- Moisture & Volatiles: 0.25% Max
- Insoluble Impurities: 0.02% Max
- Iodine Value (Wijs): 82 – 90 g I2/100g
- Saponification Value: 177 – 187 mg KOH/g
- Hydroxyl Value: 160 – 168 mg KOH/g
- Specific Gravity (at 25°C): 0.957 – 0.961 g/cm³
- Viscosity (Gardner-Holdt at 25°C): U – V (approx. 6.5 – 8.5 dPa·s)
- Primary Applications: Industrial lubricants, specialty grease manufacturing, alkyd resin synthesis, hydraulic fluids, textile auxiliaries, and chemical intermediates.

2. FIRST SPECIAL GRADE CASTOR OIL (FSG / BSS) (NDEVOLEO™ FSG)
- CAS Number: 8001-79-4 | EINECS: 232-293-8 | HS Code: 1515.30.10
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Pale yellow, clear, bright viscous liquid (refined & bleached)
- Free Fatty Acids (FFA): 0.50% – 1.00% Max (as Oleic)
- Acid Value: 1.0 – 2.0 mg KOH/g Max
- Color (Lovibond 5¼" Cell): 20.0 Yellow Max, 2.0 Red Max (Gardner Color <= 3)
- Moisture & Volatiles: 0.25% Max
- Insoluble Impurities: 0.02% Max
- Iodine Value (Wijs): 82 – 90 g I2/100g
- Saponification Value: 177 – 187 mg KOH/g
- Hydroxyl Value: 160 – 168 mg KOH/g
- Specific Gravity (at 25°C): 0.958 – 0.962 g/cm³
- Primary Applications: Polyurethane bio-polyols, coatings, heavy-duty polyamides (Nylon 11 / 610), pharmaceutical synthesis, and precision technical lubricants.

3. FIRST PRESSED DEGUMMED CASTOR OIL (NDEVOLEO™ FPD)
- CAS Number: 8001-79-4 | EINECS: 232-293-8 | HS Code: 1515.30.10
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Clear viscous amber liquid
- Free Fatty Acids (FFA): 1.00% Max (as Oleic)
- Acid Value: 2.0 mg KOH/g Max
- Color (Lovibond 1" Cell): 20 Max
- Moisture & Volatiles: 0.25% Max
- Iodine Value (Wijs): 82 – 90 g I2/100g
- Saponification Value: 177 – 187 mg KOH/g
- Hydroxyl Value: 160 – 168 mg KOH/g
- Phosphatide / Gum Content: < 15 ppm (water degummed)
- Primary Applications: Low-phosphatide polyurethane prepolymers, industrial cutting oils, specialized ester feeds.

4. CASTOR CAKE (ORGANIC FERTILIZER & MANURE) (NDEVAGRO™ CAKE)
- CAS Number: 68187-58-6 | HS Code: 2306.90.17
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Coarse brown flakes / meal pellets
- Nitrogen (N): 4.50% – 5.50% Min
- Phosphorus (as P2O5): 1.00% – 1.80% Min
- Potassium (as K2O): 1.00% – 1.50% Min
- Organic Matter: 80.0% – 85.0% Min
- Moisture Content: 8.0% – 10.0% Max
- Residual Oil: 6.0% – 8.0% (expeller process)
- Agronomic Properties: Naturally rich in organic matter and slow-release nitrogen for soil conditioning.

5. HYDROGENATED CASTOR OIL (HCO / CASTOR WAX) (NDEVWAX™ HCO)
- CAS Number: 8001-78-3 | EINECS: 232-292-2 | HS Code: 1516.20.91
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Hard, brittle, odorless white flakes or micronized powder
- Melting / Dropping Point: 85.0°C – 88.0°C
- Acid Value: 2.0 – 3.0 mg KOH/g Max
- Iodine Value (Wijs): 2.0 – 4.0 g I2/100g Max (complete catalytic hydrogenation)
- Hydroxyl Value: 155 – 165 mg KOH/g
- Saponification Value: 176 – 186 mg KOH/g
- Primary Applications: High-temperature multi-purpose lithium lubricating greases, thixotropic anti-sag additives for solvent-based paints and powder coatings, PVC external lubricants, paper water-proofing coatings, and investment casting wax formulations.

6. DEHYDRATED CASTOR OIL (DCO) (NDEVOLEO™ DCO)
- CAS Number: 64147-40-6 | EINECS: 264-705-7 | HS Code: 1518.00.11
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Clear, pale yellow, viscous drying liquid
- Specific Gravity (at 25°C): 0.926 – 0.937 g/cm³
- Acid Value: 6.0 mg KOH/g Max
- Iodine Value (Wijs): 125 – 140 g I2/100g
- Color (Gardner): 6.0 Max
- Viscosity (at 25°C): 1.5 – 3.0 poise (unbodied) / tailored bodied viscosities (up to Z3)
- Hydroxyl Value: 20 – 30 mg KOH/g Max
- Primary Applications: Fast-drying architectural varnishes, alkyd resin cooking, baking enamels, printing inks, and protective industrial coatings.

7. DCO FATTY ACID (NDEVACID™ DCO-FA)
- CAS Number: 61789-45-5 | EINECS: 263-000-8 | HS Code: 3823.19.00
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Clear, pale straw liquid
- Acid Value: 195 – 205 mg KOH/g
- Saponification Value: 198 – 207 mg KOH/g
- Iodine Value (Wijs): 130 – 145 g I2/100g
- Color (Gardner): 2.0 Max
- Conjugated Diene Acid Content: 28% – 35% Min
- Primary Applications: High-grade clear-drying stoving alkyds, epoxy ester resins, automotive primers, and synthetic coatings.

================================================================================
SECTION 2: SPECIALTY CO-PRODUCTS & DEVELOPMENTAL PIPELINE
================================================================================

SPECIALTY GRADES (AVAILABLE ON TECHNICAL ENQUIRY - 8 GRADES):
- Pale Pressed Grade (PPG) (CAS 8001-79-4): high-purity light-colored castor oil for pale stoving enamels and clear urethane resins.
- Cold Pressed Castor Oil (CAS 8001-79-4): Virgin expeller cold press, non-chemical extraction for cosmetics and pharmaceutical carrier oils.
- Castor Oil BP (British Pharmacopoeia grade) (CAS 8001-79-4): Monograph-tested pharmacopoeia grade for excipients and topical preparations.
- Castor Oil USP–NF (CAS 8001-79-4): United States Pharmacopeia–National Formulary compendial grade for oral and topical formulations.
- Castor Oil Ph. Eur. (CAS 8001-79-4): European Pharmacopoeia compendial grade for pharmaceutical and cosmetic applications.
- Castor Oil IP (CAS 8001-79-4): Indian Pharmacopoeia compendial grade for medical and therapeutic uses.
- Castor Oil JP (CAS 8001-79-4): Japanese Pharmacopoeia compendial grade for Japanese regulatory compliance.
- Cosmetic Grade Castor Oil (CAS 8001-79-4): Low-odor, bleached cosmetic oil for color cosmetics, lip care, and personal care emulsions.

ADVANCED DERIVATIVES & CO-PRODUCTS (UNDER R&D DEVELOPMENT - 17 GRADES):
- Ricinoleic Acid (CAS 141-22-0, under development): 85%+ pure hydroxy fatty acid for ester synthesis, corrosion inhibitors, and surfactants.
- 12-Hydroxystearic Acid (12-HSA) (CAS 106-14-9, under development): Primary gelling fatty acid (Drop Point 75°C–78°C) for multipurpose automotive and industrial lithium greases.
- Refined Glycerin 99.5% (CAS 56-81-5, under development): High-purity pure vegetable glycerol from derivative co-product streams.
- Crude Glycerin 80% (CAS 56-81-5, under development): Industrial-grade unrefined co-product stream.
- High Protein Castor Meal (CAS 68424-10-2, under development): De-oiled high-nitrogen meal (6.0%–7.0% N) for organic horticulture and tea plantations.
- Sodium Sulphate Anhydrous (CAS 7757-82-6, under development): 99.4% purity crystalline co-product for detergent builders and glass.
- Sebacic Acid (CAS 111-20-6, under development): Pure C10 dicarboxylic acid for bio-based polyamides (Nylon 6.10, Nylon 10.10) and jet lubricant diesters.
- Bio-Polyurethane Polyols (CAS 68442-88-6, under development): Modified bio-polyols with engineered hydroxyl functionality for rigid spray foams, flexible elastomers, and adhesives.
- Dioctyl Sebacate / DOS (CAS 122-62-3, under development): Low-temperature synthetic lubricating ester.
- Dibutyl Sebacate / DBS (CAS 109-43-3, under development): High-efficiency plasticizer for vinyl polymers and pharmaceutical film coatings.
- Lithium 12-Hydroxystearate (CAS 7620-77-1, under development): Pre-reacted pre-reacted soap powder for direct grease manufacturing.
- Calcium 12-Hydroxystearate (CAS 3159-62-4, under development): Water-resistant pre-reacted soap for marine greases and calcium-complex greases.
- Zinc Ricinoleate (CAS 13040-19-2, under development): Coordinated zinc active salt that chemically traps volatile mercaptans and amine malodors in personal care deodorants.
- Zinc Undecylenate (CAS 557-08-4, under development): Topical antifungal active for pharmaceuticals and footcare powders.
- Methyl Ricinoleate (CAS 141-24-2, under development): Fatty acid methyl ester for diesel fuel lubricity improvement and specialty synthesis.
- Methyl 12-Hydroxystearate (CAS 141-23-1, under development): Intermediate for synthetic waxes and lubricant additives.
- Blown Oxidized Castor Oil (CAS 68187-84-8, under development): Thermally blown viscous polymerized fluid for printing inks, lithographic varnishes, and rubber plasticizers.

================================================================================
SECTION 3: PACKAGING, LOGISTICS & EXPORT INFRASTRUCTURE
================================================================================

BULK PACKAGING FORMATS:
1. ISO Tank Containers: 20,000 – 24,000 Liters (approx. 20–24 MT net). Dedicated chemical-grade stainless steel tanks (T11 specification) with steam heating coils.
2. Flexitanks: 21,500 – 24,000 Liters (approx. 21.5 MT net) in standard 20 ft GP ocean containers. Multi-layer virgin polyethylene with automated single-valve discharge.
3. Intermediate Bulk Containers (IBC Totes): 1,000 Liters (approx. 900–950 kg net). High-density polyethylene inner bottle with galvanized tubular steel cage on four-way entry pallet.
4. Steel Drums: 200 kg net weight, 216.5 liter gross capacity, new tight-head unlined or epoxy-phenolic lined drums (UN 1A1 rated for export).
5. Multi-Wall Paper Bags: 25 kg net weight, 3-ply kraft paper bags with internal polyethylene moisture barrier liner for flakes/powder (HCO, 12-HSA soaps). Palletized (1,000 kg / pallet) with UV shrink wrap.
6. HDPE Woven Sacks: 50 kg net weight laminated bags for expeller castor cake fertilizer.

LOGISTICS CORRIDOR:
- Processing Location: Deodar, Gujarat — heart of North Gujarat's castor farming region.
- Rail & Highway: NH-27 arterial multi-lane connectivity.
- Major Export Seaports:
  * Kandla Port (Deendayal Port Trust, INIXY) — 180 km from plant.
  * Mundra Port (Adani Ports & SEZ, INMUN) — 240 km from plant.
- Lead Times: Ex-works dispatch 3–5 working days; Port FOB clearance 7–10 working days upon LC / commercial confirmation.

================================================================================
SECTION 4: QUALITY ASSURANCE & BUYER QUALIFICATION
================================================================================

TESTING METHODS:
- In-house laboratory analytical testing adhering strictly to ASTM (D960, D555, D1959, D1980), AOCS (Cc 1-25, Cd 3-25, Cd 1-25, Cd 13-60), and ISO international testing protocols.
- Analytical capabilities include gas chromatography (fatty acid methyl ester profiling), Karl Fischer coulometric moisture titration, Lovibond tintometer colorimetry, and Brookfield rotational viscometry.

DOCUMENTATION DELIVERED WITH EVERY CONSIGNMENT:
1. Batch Certificate of Analysis (COA) containing lot-specific analytical parameters.
2. Technical Data Sheet (TDS) with complete typical property envelope.
3. 16-Section Safety Data Sheet (SDS) compliant with UN GHS (Revision 9) safety data sheet guidelines.
4. Certificate of Origin (COO) issued by recognized Indian Chamber of Commerce or Export Inspection Council (EIC).
5. Non-manipulation certificate, export inspection documentation (where required), and commercial export documentation.
6. Third-party pre-shipment sampling and sealing (SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek) supported at buyer request.
